question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `memorySearch.queryInstructionTemplate` and expose model-ID-based query formatting through the plugin SDK?
rationale: The code can implement either direction safely, but choosing a new configuration and external SDK contract—and assigning ownership for model-specific prompt policy—requires maintainer product and API judgment.

options.title: Sponsor the shared opt-in contract
options.body: Accept the boolean configuration and shared helper as the canonical query-formatting boundary, with raw defaults and query-only behavior preserved.

options.title: Keep formatting provider-owned
options.body: Replace the public SDK/config surface with a narrower provider-specific mechanism or existing generic transform seam before reopening.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Leave OpenAI-compatible query formatting to operators or provider plugins until maintainers want to own model-specific templates.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the shared opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Accept the boolean configuration and shared helper as the canonical query-formatting boundary, with raw defaults and query-only behavior preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged history most strongly connects this person to the current memory embedding adapter and provider ownership boundaries affected by the decision.
